correctness.rationale: Integrating along the tree gives all edge gradients, and differentiating yields Q=-BBᵀC with diagonal -2c_e and absolute off-diagonal column entries A_fe c_e. The right derivative of the weighted ℓ¹ induced norm at the identity is the maximum weighted column candidate, each attained on a cut indicator. Subdividing time proves the bound and the right derivative forces its exponent. For M=C(A-2I) the positive Perron vector after a scalar shift attains the minimum, and a positive left eigenvector forces equality for an optimizer. Similarity proves the symmetric formula and congruence the sign. Paths and the claw have line-graph radii below and equal to 2. Every other tree supplies a K4 or a triangle with an attached vertex in the line graph, forcing radius above 2. With consistent path orientation, Q=(A-2I)C, and its eigenvalues are minus the positive eigenvalues of BᵀCB; this includes the scalar one-edge case. Contractive means nonexpansive; the claw admits no strictly positive prefactor-one decay rate. The frozen checker was inspected, not run, and the proof does not require its finite samples.
